requirement_dispositions.requirement: Both complete vehicle bodies enter one sourced crossing from different highways; original frame/time joins report entry delta and right-hand approach geometry without inventing a legal simultaneity cutoff
requirement_dispositions.evidence_or_gap: Original crossing history, road geometry and frame map; finalizer body_entry_timing. Statutory approximate-time and right-of-way judgments remain unresolved.

requirement_dispositions.requirement: A reviewed governing signal inventory and both original Native light states at body entry identify the controlled-device comparison while leaving official status and statutory inoperability unresolved
requirement_dispositions.evidence_or_gap: Distinct Native light IDs, lane context, original signal/frame history and source-camera head review; finalizer signal_at_entry. Physical head pixels and official status remain unverified.

requirement_dispositions.requirement: For the signal-Off branch, source-selected stop references and original zero-speed, entry-order and occupancy histories retain subsection-4 stop and yield evidence without a legal stop/yield verdict
requirement_dispositions.evidence_or_gap: Original stop context/history and frame joins; finalizer stop_order. Recorded zero speed is an observation, not a statutory stop.

requirement_dispositions.requirement: The opposite-direction left-turn exception requires approach intention and trajectory evidence even though this selected travel comparison is not a left-turn test
requirement_dispositions.evidence_or_gap: Source-bound planned routes, original actor headings and frame joins are measured by finalizer turn_context; opposite-direction, intent and statutory exception judgments remain unresolved pending physical map and trajectory review.
